title: Election Commission Hall
purpose: Election-commissions sector card and electoral-integrity surfaces.
story: An election commission hall holding sealed ballot containers — the custody of a nation's choice, guarded and unmarked.
environment: A high committee hall, sealed containers ranged on long tables under a tall ceiling, the room beyond in shadow.
architecture: Formal institutional interior — pilastered walls, a deep cornice, tall shuttered windows receding into gloom.

people.notes: A single steward at the far table, seen from behind in silhouette; no face toward the camera.

composition: Tables of sealed containers leading the eye down the hall, a pool of warm light over the nearest, deep negative space toward the cornice.
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; containers carry no markings.
